Game Overview
Format: Fast-paced 1v1 arcade football (soccer) matches featuring oversized-head characters.
Modes: Single-player against CPU, local two-player on the same device, and browser/online multiplayer.
Objective: Score more goals than your opponent before the match timer expires by jumping, heading, kicking, and utilizing special power shots. 
Controls
Single Player (Keyboard): Use arrow keys or WASD to move, and keys like Z, X, K, or L to jump and shoot.
Mobile / Touch: On-screen virtual buttons handle movement, jumping, and special attack triggers.
